parent_objective: design no-training replay gate for M964 direction-target actor-fit candidates
blocked_by: M964 produced objective-level candidate checkpoints but no full replay/proof gate has been designed
invalidates: promotion or PPO continuation before replay-gating M964 candidates

public_gates: M965 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M965 must design public replay gates for M964 candidate checkpoints
M965 must include M267/M264 full surface and behavior seeds

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs replay/proof gate after M964 objective-level candidate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proof gate design only; no training, no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if replay gate omits M267/M264 full surface

if replay design exposes missing proof rows, route to proof-surface refresh

success_criteria: training, PPO, and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design recommends promotion before replay gates
